plugin.note: Ahrim is the only ranged-weak brother, so the guide carves out a dedicated ranged kit. Air spells or a Shadow let you mage him like the others.

requirements: Access to Ahrim the Blighted's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Ahrim is the only ranged-weak brother, so the guide carves out a dedicated ranged kit. Air spells or a Shadow let you mage him like the others.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.
Use listed secondary weapons only where their combat style or phase role is relevant.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Ahrim is the only ranged-weak brother, so the guide carves out a dedicated ranged kit. Air spells or a Shadow let you mage him like the others.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Ahrim is the only ranged-weak brother, so the guide carves out a dedicated ranged kit. Air spells or a Shadow let you mage him like the others.

methods.label: Barrows route
methods.summary: Reach Barrows with a Barrows teleport or Mort'ton route, then clear mounds while managing the recurring underground Prayer drain.
recommendedFor: Boss Slayer assignments that roll Ahrim
steps: Use a Barrows teleport, a player-owned house portal, Mort'ton teleport, Morytania legs, or fairy ring route to reach the mounds.
Enter Ahrim's central mound when ready to spend prayer points.
Use Protect from Magic and a ranged setup unless using air spells or Tumeken's shadow.
Carry restore if Ahrim's Strength drain matters for the rest of the route.
notes: Ghommal's hilt 2 or higher nullifies the Barrows Prayer-draining effect.
Ahrim is commonly killed early because he uses magic and can drain Strength.

methods.label: Protection prayer kill
methods.summary: Use Protect from Magic and ranged accuracy prayers to kill Ahrim quickly, or skip the ranged switch when using air magic or Shadow.
steps: Turn on Protect from Magic before Ahrim attacks.
Use ranged weapons and ranged damage prayers for the fastest non-Shadow kill.
Use air spells or Tumeken's shadow if avoiding extra switches.
Use special attacks on Ahrim if they speed up the rotation.
risks: Ahrim can drain Strength, which slows later melee kills if no restore is carried.
Prayer drains every 18 seconds underground unless prevented by Combat Achievement rewards.
notes: Ahrim is the only brother whose primary listed weakness is ranged.
All brothers also have a 50% air elemental weakness.

methods.label: Tunnel safespot
methods.summary: If Ahrim appears in the tunnels, fight him with Protect from Magic; reserve safespot tricks mainly for melee brothers.
steps: Keep Protect from Magic active when Ahrim spawns in a tunnel room.
Use ladder and corridor geometry for spacing if needed.
Avoid relying on melee-brother kiting patterns because Ahrim attacks with magic.
notes: Tunnel ladder and corridor safespots are most valuable against melee brothers.
Prayer management is usually more important than pathing against Ahrim.
